- Duplicate-by-E.164 already works since the controller compares `getTelephone()`, now E.164 on both sides.

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '^.*\S.*$'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '^.*\S.*$'
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^\D*(\d\D*){10}$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email
          description: The email address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered. Defaults to the server's current date when omitted.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone

              format: int32
              minimum: 0

## Summary

Telephone numbers are now stored and returned in E.164 form, with duplicates compared on those values.

**Changes (3 files):**

1. **`model/TelephoneNumber.java`** (new) — a small cohesive helper holding the normalization: strips spaces/dashes/brackets; keeps a leading `+` and country code when present; otherwise assumes `+61` and drops a single leading `0` from the national digits. `null` in → `null` out. Being the only method in its own class, it carries essentially zero surrounding complexity.

2. **`model/Owner.java`** — `setTelephone` becomes a one-line delegation to `TelephoneNumber.toE164(...)`, and the field's Bean Validation switched from the old 10-digit rule (`@Digits` + `@Pattern("^[0-9]{10}$")`, plus its now-unused import) to the E.164 shape `@Pattern("^\\+[0-9]{8,15}$")`. No other method in the class was touched.

3. **`resources/openapi.yml`** — relaxed the `telephone` request pattern from "exactly 10 digits" to "optional `+`, separators, 8–15 digits" so the DTO layer rejects unformattable input (e.g. `"12"`) with **400** via the existing validation path, while every accepted input normalizes to a valid `^\+[0-9]{8,15}$` (so entity validation never 500s).

**What was deliberately left untouched:** the controller's duplicate check (`existing.getTelephone().equals(owner.getTelephone())`) already compares E.164 values now that both sides are normalized — the largest class in the change set needed no edit.

Verified behavior: `0412 345 678` → `+61412345678`, `+64 21 123 456` → `+6421123456`, `12` → 400. `Tests run: 3, Failures: 0, Errors: 0`.
